other_failure_modes.name: Missing Grouped Validation for Sensor Data
other_failure_modes.description: For human activity recognition tasks, multiple rows often correspond to continuous windows from the same subject. Using standard StratifiedKFold rather than GroupKFold can cause severe data leakage, as highly correlated adjacent windows from the same subject end up in both training and validation sets.

summary: The agent implements a solid 5-fold cross-validation pipeline with three complementary multiclass models. However, it fails to perform any feature engineering, uses arbitrary, untuned weights for its ensemble, and potentially risks subject-level data leakage by not grouping its validation splits.
